Yunidragon.identity: The OG blue Yunidragon: a slender upright long-necked baby dragon, large amber-brown eyes, a broad cyan forehead crest with blue spots, blue cheek and dorsal surfaces with light mint-cyan underbelly, coral-red layered ear fins, four short clawed legs, a long tapering tail, and the recognizable OG facial features. Preserve these distinctive markings and body proportions; do not turn it into a stocky winged dragon or another animal.

Yunikles.identity: The exact OG Yunikles: a friendly upright yellow equine creature with a round belly, long slender legs and turquoise hoof cuffs, a silver Greek-patterned helmet with an angular orange plume, large turquoise-rimmed brown eyes, an orange scarf with a turquoise tab, and a flowing curled orange tail. Preserve this helmet, plume, scarf, tail, face and proportions; it is not a generic lion or stock unicorn.
Yunikles.source: Cached OG BNB Yunipals reference: /root/protobits/tmp/imagegen/bnb-references/01-10001168855-unikles.png; original token ID 10001168855. Character reference only; lunar scene is not part of the booster design.

Yunichick.identity: The exact OG Yunichick: a slim upright bird-pony hybrid with huge warm red-brown eyes, a short pointed blue beak and blue eye masks, a layered teal/coral feather crown, long slender legs with blue hoof-like toes, small folded side wings with red/blue feathers, fine curved feather markings on the body and a long curled tail with a feather tip. Preserve these distinctive features and OG stance; do not turn it into a round generic chicken.
Yunichick.source: Cached OG BNB Yunipals reference: /root/protobits/tmp/imagegen/bnb-references/02-10003450055-unichick.png; original token ID 10003450055. Character reference only; lunar scene is not part of the booster design.

Yuniturtle.identity: The exact OG Yuniturtle: a small long-necked swimming turtle with a round expressive face, huge warm brown eyes behind silver/gold round diving goggles and a red strap, a short muzzle, blue mop-like head tendrils and neck plates, a small rounded blue shell, four broad paddle-shaped flippers with blue spots, and red ring markings along the neck/body. Preserve the goggles, shell, flippers, long neck and floating/swimming OG silhouette; do not turn it into a squat land tortoise.
Yuniturtle.source: Cached OG BNB Yunipals reference: /root/protobits/tmp/imagegen/bnb-references/04-10001644187-uniturtle.png; original token ID 10001644187. Character reference only; lunar scene is not part of the booster design.

Yunifairy.identity: The exact OG Yunifairy: a hovering small rounded pony-fairy with swept curled magenta forelock and mane, large golden-brown eyes with prominent golden-yellow lashes, two large butterfly wings with purple/pink panels and yellow scalloped edges and circular spots, a yellow star pendant at the chest, and four short dangling legs with yellow cuffs and small magenta toes. Preserve the OG face, mane, butterfly wing shapes, star pendant, hover pose and body proportions; do not make it a humanoid fairy.
Yunifairy.source: Cached OG BNB Yunipals reference: /root/protobits/tmp/imagegen/bnb-references/03-10001059898-unifairy.png; original token ID 10001059898. Character reference only; lunar scene is not part of the booster design.

branding.evidence: Live HTML references index-iS6SCmXt.css; its palette and display font match apps/yunipals-home-web/tailwind.config.ts.

rules: Crisp dimensional monster, clean face and contours
Sparse body glints only for glitter variants
Holographic finish concentrated in the background
Golden spiral or faceted diamond forehead horn
Blend viewer finish with calibrated subject and star masks

Yellow.description: OG warm soft buttery yellow/golden cream in the highlights, muted amber shadows; preserve its light pastel character, not acid neon yellow.
Yellow.source: Original OG Yellow Yunidragon reference from /root/protopals-ponder/artwork/refs/yunidragon_yellow.png; color-only authority, token identity not established

Green.description: OG fresh mid-green with yellow-lime lit surfaces and underbody, a deeper leaf-green midtone, soft yellow-green highlights and restrained saturation; no cyan/mint/aqua cast and no electric neon green.
Green.source: Original OG Green Yunidragon reference from /root/protopals-ponder/artwork/refs/yunidragon_green.png; color-only authority, token identity not established

Blue.description: OG cyan/aqua blue highlights and underbody with medium royal-blue face and back surfaces; preserve the balanced soft OG tones rather than a uniform saturated blue.
Blue.source: Original OG Blue Yunidragon reference from /root/protopals-ponder/artwork/refs/yunidragon_blue.png; color-only authority, token identity not established

Red.description: OG soft warm coral/salmon-red, pale peach-pink highlights and warmer terracotta/red shadows; lighter peach/orange underbody transitions, not primary fire-engine red, scarlet, neon red or a uniformly saturated red coating.
Red.source: Original OG Red Yunidragon reference from /root/protopals-ponder/artwork/refs/yunidragon_red.png; color-only authority, token identity not established

Purple.description: OG soft lilac/lavender and muted purple shadows with its original complementary highlights; not electric violet or oversaturated magenta.
Purple.source: Original OG Purple Yunidragon reference from /root/protopals-ponder/artwork/refs/yunidragon_purple.png; color-only authority, token identity not established

Yuniturtle:Green.description: OG green Uniturtle: light yellow-lime skin/body/flippers, fresh leaf-green hair/mop tendrils, a leaf-green shell and green flipper spots, pink-magenta goggle strap, neck ring markings and rear-flipper band, purple iris, silver/gold goggle rims. The hair, shell and flipper spots must be GREEN, never blue. Match these exact corresponding colors to the pictured OG; the requested golden spiral horn overrides its original horn.
Yuniturtle:Green.source: Actual OG Uniturtle #1000000214; https://meta.polkamon.com/meta?id=1000000214; code T04C02H10B01G00; image https://drive.polychainmonsters.com/ipfs/QmSQxGf3feNR6uvyaU21estDBDKiwicFGaFiUxcxA8eteA

Yunichick:Red.description: OG red Unichick: soft salmon/coral skin with pale peach-pink highlights; mint-green irises and mint-green body markings; layered coral/pink forehead feathers with mint-green rear crown accents; red beak, red eye-mask/wing feather outlines, red feet and red tail-tip feathers with green inner wing feathers. No blue beak, blue eye masks, blue feathers or blue feet. Match the actual red OG colorway; the requested diamond horn overrides its original gold spiral horn.
Yunichick:Red.source: Actual OG Unichick #1000000017; https://meta.polkamon.com/meta?id=1000000017; code T07C05H01B01G00; image https://drive.polychainmonsters.com/ipfs/QmTSBMBxGKFjqMvvxzbaa9BEyhagAUmyooWMpyPqmpTJLq
